decisions.reason: Its proven use by a major public customer and integration with more than 30 government APIS schemes place results well above aspiration, so a large expanding security firm would keep it.

It remains strategically close to the core security offer and the firm has some slack to continue a still-uncertain product, but limited visible performance keeps withdrawal risk material if results do not rise toward aspiration.

The platform is closely aligned with the firm's airport and border-security activities, and having survived the earlier portfolio pruning it is more likely to be retained unless clearer underperformance appears.
